engines.description:
The image engines to ask: each an engine's roster name or a category standing for its image engines;
none for every image engine.

language.description: The language the query is written in, such as "ko" or "en"; any where absent.

limit.description: How many pictures to answer, 1 to 30; 10 where absent.

pacing.description: Whose requests are paced together: one name for each run's reading.
